name: Loom Tension
description: The Post, the seat, the hum.

pages.title: Tension Post
pages.text:
**Goal:** raise a Post and seat the first token.\
You need logs, a **Binding Knot**, and a scrap of **Frayed Thread**.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Logs, a Binding Knot, and a scrap of Thread make a **Tension Post**. Raise one on the pad. Right-click it with a Strand token to seat that Strand; the notch lights, the tribe chimes, and the Post starts to hum.\
**Check:** the Soil notch is lit, and the pad starts mending you near the Post.

pages.title: What Tension does
pages.text: Seated Strands are **Loom Tension**. It is not a bar and it does not nag. It changes the pad.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Near the Post: the pad mends you (Soil). It feeds you a little (Sprout). Fall damage stops within sight of it (Claw). Hands quicken (five Strands). Luck (Sigil). And the horizon warms, one Strand at a time.

pages.title: Spun at the Post
pages.text:
**Goal:** spin **Braid Cord**, then a **Spindle Loom Fragment**, at the Post — not the bench.\
You need a **Strand Filament**; **March Stone** once all nine are seated.\
**Braid Cord**: right-click with a Strand Filament. The Post is the only requirement.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
**Spindle Loom Fragment**: right-click with a March stone once all nine are seated. Seat the Fragment to Reweave.\
**Check:** a Strand Filament at the Post gives you Braid Cord, and a Fragment after nine seats plus March Stone.
